Host modulation of a bound knob draws its played value with no plugin code
A plugin's own modulation shows only when it publishes one

installed_sdk.rationale: StateStore gains set_display_modulation / clear_display_modulation / displayed_modulation and an RAII watch_modulation, all on the installed state header. The publish call is one relaxed atomic store, so a plugin's own modulator can call it from the audio thread; it is display-only and never reaches automation or the parameter value. bind_parameter on a Knob or Fader now draws the host's modulation offset (CLAP param_mod) with no plugin code, and AutoUi binds through bind_parameter so its controls follow automation playback. A plugin that never publishes shows no internal-modulation marker.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No offline Timeline command is added or altered; the change is editor display of a value the processor already plays.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation is added, removed or changed.

live_product_control.rationale: No product control, grant or policy projection is created. The displayed modulated value is read-only UI state; parameter values, automation and gestures are unchanged.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time authoring capability is added or altered.
